name: pers_revision_flow_leaders_2026-09-25
objective: maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs
strategy: I bet on analyst revision flow, not target levels: every name has net target raises across at least three distinct firms over the trailing 90 days, and I deliberately excluded high-upside names where the flow is negative (ALB -12, FLUT -15, CEG -6, OKLO -4). The book is pharma/biotech plus software plus semis, each with a dated Q4 print or PDUFA inside the six-month window so the flow can be confirmed or broken by real events. I would be wrong if the revision flow mean-reverts: a single guidance cut or CRL at any of the 13 names flips its flow negative and the stock de-rates faster than SPY.
what_i_did_not_buy: ALB|net_raises -12 across 11 firms, flow is negative
QUBT|targets dispersed $10-$32, no converged revision flow
